description: Source code implementing encryption and decryption functions for EAD protocol, including key setup, IV management, message hashing, encryption, and decryption.

methods.name: ead_set_key
methods.description: Initializes AES encryption/decryption contexts and IVs based on provided secret key.

methods.name: ead_encrypt_message
methods.description: Encrypts and hashes a message, preparing it for transmission.

methods.name: ead_decrypt_message
methods.description: Decrypts and verifies a received message, returning its payload length if valid.
